title: Are we late?
grammar: Prepositions on and at; Verb be: information questions with What time, When, and What day
vocab_topic: Clock times; School subjects; Days of the week; Expressions of punctuality
pair_game: Show a time with your hands like a clock. Your partner says the time. Then swap!

grammar_box.title: What time? When? What day?
grammar_box.tip: at + time (at 9:00), on + day (on Monday) — vaqt uchun at, kun uchun on

questions: What time do you wake up on school days?
What is your favorite school subject? What day do you have it?
Are you usually on time for school or are you sometimes late?
What time does your school start and finish?
What do you do on weekends? What time do you usually get up?
Which days of the week do you like the most? Why?
What time do you eat dinner with your family?
Is it important to be on time? Why or why not?
What subject do you have on Monday mornings?
What time do you usually go to sleep? Is that early or late?
starters: My favourite subject is … . I have it on …
My school starts at … and finishes at …
On weekends I … . I get up at …
Yes, it is. / No, it isn’t. Because …
I go to sleep at … . It’s …
samples: What time do you wake up on school days?
I wake up **at seven o’clock**. My mom says, “Bobur, get up!”
What is your favorite school subject? What day do you have it?
My favourite subject is **Art**. I have it **on Wednesday**.
What time does your school start and finish?
My school starts **at eight o’clock** and finishes **at one o’clock**.

survey.title: Class survey
survey.question: What time do you go to sleep?

game.title: Spin and say
game.rules: Spin the pencil. Read the prompt. Answer in a full sentence with at or on!
items: What time do you wake up?
Your favourite day of the week?
What time do you watch TV?
Are you late or on time today?

mini_talk.title: My school day
plan: Say what time you wake up
Say your favourite subject and its day
Say what time you go to sleep
mini_talk.model: Hi! I’m Madina. I wake up **at** seven o’clock. My school starts **at** eight o’clock. I’m never late! My favourite subject is Music. I have it **on** Tuesday and **on** Thursday. I go home **at** one o’clock. **On** Saturday I play with my friends. I go to sleep **at** half past nine.

cando: use at for times and on for days
ask What time, When and What day questions
